summary: Bohol 2nd District representative with 69 principal-authored bills, of which only a few touched rubric topics in this review: travel-tax abolition, a false-information bill and a co-authored national minimum wage. Evidence is too thin to score social values, civil liberties or democratic institutions.
caveat: Only three rubric-relevant bills were surfaced from 69; the other bills were not individually reviewed. Economic 0 reflects two opposing signals, not missing data.

economic.label: Center / mixed
economic.rationale: Travel-tax abolition (+2, tax cut) versus co-authored national minimum wage (-2). Two issues, both thin.
